source.title: Keystone metro cost factor (BLS OEWS wages, see README cost method)

factor.note: MSA 33260 Midland, TX: labour index L=0.881, materials M=1.0. 5/5 trades (OEWS May 2024 via O*NET Texas local-wages search extracts). Ratios to US: 47-2031 0.813; 47-2111 0.952; 47-2152 0.884; 47-2061 0.874; 49-9021 0.951. L = 0.881; factor = 0.40*0.881 + 0.60*1.00 = 0.95. M=1.00 (default, no public citable reason to adjust).

cost.method: Factor = 0.40*L + 0.60*M, rounded to 2 decimals. L = weighted mean of (metro annual median wage / US national annual median wage) for SOC 47-2031 Carpenters (0.30), 47-2111 Electricians (0.20), 47-2152 Plumbers/Pipefitters/Steamfitters (0.20), 47-2061 Construction Laborers (0.20), 49-9021 HVAC Mechanics/Installers (0.10), from BLS OEWS; weights renormalised over occupations available for the MSA. M = materials index, 1.00 for all Texas metros (no public citable reason to adjust); qualitative materials notes per MSA. Wave 2 (2026-10-11): all five trades retrieved from O*NET Texas local-wages pages (OEWS May 2024) via search extracts (Secondary); HVAC missing for 28660, 47380, 46340, 17780 (weights renormalised there). provisional removed for every MSA with >=4 trades.

plainLanguage: Midland still uses the 2018 residential building code and the 2015 energy code (with local changes), but the newer 2023 electrical code. Midland is in a hot, dry climate zone (3B). Your permit set must include a Manual J heating/cooling load calculation and an energy compliance statement. Single-family zones are SF-1, SF-2 and SF-3 (old names 1F-1 to 1F-3); we could not read their setbacks, so check your plat and the city. In a floodplain inside the city, the floor must be at least 1 ft above the 100-year flood level. Water, sewer and road impact fees are charged at permit time based on meter size. The area has had small to moderate oil-field-related earthquakes (largest about magnitude 5.2 in 2022); building codes do not require extra design, but crack-tolerant details are sensible.
